symptom: Running an external entity's describe output (create or modify external entity, either form) turns each attribute's Rest$ODataMappedValue into a DomainModels$StoredValue (RemoteName/RemoteType/Filterable... gone), re-mints attribute $IDs on the `from odata client` form, and rewrites String(36) as unlimited
cause: Both rewrite paths rebuilt attributes from the AST, which has no spelling for the OData mapping; the `from odata client` path minted fresh IDs; describe external entity printed GetTypeName() (`String`) instead of formatAttributeType
insight: Carry per attribute by name what the statement cannot spell, in the shared merge, and enumerate every path that rebuilds attributes: there were two statements for one document kind
